episode.name: md_company_batch_components_2026-05-16
episode.source_desc: Batch episode: Sanhua, Hengli, Tuopu, Joyson, Inovance, Estun, Leadshine, Wolong, Hesai, Robosense, Omnivision, FortiorTech, Leaderdrive, Moons, Shuanghuan, Zhaowei, Keli, Glorymica, Dobot, Fourier, Xpeng, UBTECH, 凌云光, 双林股份, 广汽集团, 汉威科技

entities.name: Sanhua
entities.summary: 三花智控 (SZSE:002050 / HKEX:2050). World's largest maker of refrigeration/AC control parts and a top global auto-thermal-management supplier. Holds #1 global share in 4-way reversing valves, electronic expansion valves, microchannel heat exchangers and Omega pumps. Major Tesla thermal-management supplier; expanding into humanoid-robot thermal/actuator components.

entities.name: Hengli Hydraulic
entities.summary: 恒立液压 (SSE:601100). China's largest and most-profitable hydraulics company with the only full domestic stack — high-pressure cylinders, axial-piston pumps, multi-way valves, hydraulic motors and high-precision castings. Customers in excavators, TBMs, marine equipment, AWP, wind. Since 2022 extending into machine-tool linear-motion components and humanoid-robot linear actuators.

entities.name: Tuopu
entities.summary: 拓普集团 (SSE:601689). China Tier-1 auto-parts supplier; one of the most-diversified domestic platforms — NVH, interiors/exteriors, lightweight castings/forgings, smart-cockpit modules, thermal management, suspension, air suspension and intelligent-driving 'by-wire' actuators (IBS, EPS). Tesla key supplier; humanoid-component pivot underway.

entities.name: Joyson Electronics
entities.summary: 均胜电子 (SSE:600699 / HKEX:2206). Global Tier-1 auto supplier headquartered in Ningbo. Two product families: (i) Auto safety — airbags, seat belts, steering wheels, integrated occupant protection; (ii) Auto electronics — smart-cockpit domain controllers, ADAS domain controllers, central compute, V2X, HMI, NEV power electronics (BMS / OBC / DC-DC).

entities.name: Inovance
entities.summary: 汇川技术 (SZSE:300124). China's largest industrial-automation and servo company; vertically integrated motion-control stack from sensors → controllers → drives → motors → precision mechanics. Also NEV powertrain (motor, MCU, e-axle, OBC, DC/DC) and elevator-control systems.

entities.name: Estun
entities.summary: 埃斯顿 (SZSE:002747). China's largest domestic industrial-robot OEM. FY2025 #1 in China industrial-robot shipments (across domestic + foreign brands) — first Chinese OEM to outrank Fanuc, Yaskawa, ABB, KUKA at home. Vertically integrated: AC servo drives, motion controllers, CNC, machine vision modules.

entities.name: Leadshine
entities.summary: 雷赛智能 (SZSE:002979). Shenzhen Nanshan-based pure-play motion-control component supplier — stepper motors/drivers, AC servo motors/drivers, motion-control cards, PLCs, encoders, and recently humanoid frameless torque motors, coreless motors, harmonic-joint modules and dexterous-hand assemblies.

entities.name: Wolong Electric
entities.summary: 卧龙电驱 (SSE:600580). China's largest and globally leading motor + motion-control group. 30+ plants across China, Italy, Austria, Germany, UK, Mexico, Vietnam, US, Korea. Five segments: explosion-proof drives, industrial drives, HVAC drives, new-energy transport drives, and robotics components/systems.

entities.name: Hesai
entities.summary: 禾赛 (NASDAQ:HSAI / HKEX:2525). Shanghai-based 3D LiDAR maker. Sells to passenger-car OEMs for ADAS and to robotics customers — Robotaxi, Robovan, robot mowers, quadrupeds, humanoids. ASIC-centric vertically-integrated LiDAR architecture targeting automotive cost curve.

entities.name: RoboSense
entities.summary: 速腾聚创 (HKEX:2498). Shenzhen-headquartered LiDAR + AI-perception maker founded 2014 by HIT researchers. World's largest passenger-car LiDAR supplier by volume — 33.5% of automotive LiDAR installs in 2024. Expanding into humanoid + service-robot LiDAR.

entities.name: Omnivision
entities.summary: 豪威集团 (SSE:603501 / HKEX:00501). Shanghai-headquartered fabless semiconductor designer. World's #3 digital image-sensor supplier — 13.7% 2024 global revenue share (behind Sony, Samsung).

entities.name: Fortior Technology
entities.summary: 峰岹科技 (SSE:688279). Shenzhen-based fabless BLDC/PMSM motor-driver IC designer. Product lines: motor-control MCUs / ASICs, high-voltage gate-driver ICs, MOSFETs, smart-power modules. Unique in not using ARM Cortex-M — proprietary 'ME' (Motor Engine) core.

entities.name: Leaderdrive
entities.summary: 绿的谐波 (SSE:688017). Suzhou-based precision-transmission specialist. China's largest harmonic-reducer producer; planetary-roller screws, mechatronics actuator integrators. Customer base: industrial robots, humanoid robots, machine tools, semi equipment, medical.

entities.name: Moons' Industries
entities.summary: 上海鸣志电器 (SSE:603728). Shanghai precision small-frame motion-control parts maker — hybrid steppers, BLDC + brushed motors, coreless micro-motors, AC servo motors/drivers, frameless torque motors, precision reducers, linear-transmission modules. Subsidiary Magntek (鸣志派博思) — LED drivers + smart lighting.

entities.name: Shuanghuan Drive
entities.summary: 双环传动 (SZSE:002472). China's largest independent precision-gear maker; dominant domestic supplier of RV (cycloidal) reducers to industrial-robot OEMs. Founded 1980 in Yuhuan, Zhejiang. Products: EV e-axles, commercial-vehicle transmissions, machinery transmissions, robotic-vacuum gears, industrial-robot joints, humanoid components.

entities.name: Keli Sensing (corp)
entities.summary: 柯力传感 (SSE:603662). Dominant Chinese strain-gauge force / weighing sensor supplier; the most-aggressive A-share entrant into humanoid + cobot 6-axis force/torque sensors since 2023. (Distinct entity record from 'Keli Sensing' product-listing — same company, force-sensor business unit.)

entities.name: Glorymica
entities.summary: 荣泰电工 (SSE:603119). Zhejiang-based specialty-materials company; pivoted from cable mica tape to dominate global EV battery-pack 3D mica thermal-runaway-protection (TRP) parts. 2021-24: low-key share gains supplying Tesla, Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz.

entities.name: Dobot
entities.summary: 越疆科技 (HKEX:2432). World #2 / China #1 pure-play cobot maker (2023 shipments) — ~13% global cobot share. Full-stack 4-axis + 6-axis cobot range from sub-USD-1k educational desktop arms to industrial CRA series with welding/palletising packages. Entering humanoids.

entities.name: Xpeng
entities.summary: Xpeng / 小鹏汽车 (NYSE:XPEV / HKEX:9868). Vertically-integrated Chinese smart-EV maker focused on the RMB 150-300k mainstream-to-premium segment. FY2025 deliveries 429,445 (+125.9% yoy). Seven models: MONA M03, Next P7, P7+/EREV, G6/EREV, G7/EREV, G9, X9/EREV. Building in-house Iron humanoid.

entities.name: UBTECH (corp)
entities.summary: 优必选 (HKEX:9880). First listed pure-play humanoid-robot company globally; HKEX IPO Dec-2023 at HKD 90/share. Walker S / Walker S2 industrial humanoid deployed at BYD, NIO, Geely, FAW, Foxconn factories. (Duplicate of 'UBTECH' first-seeded with Agibot — kept here for completeness; dedup will merge.)

entities.name: Fourier Intelligence (corp)
entities.summary: 傅利叶智能 / FFTAI. Shanghai humanoid maker founded 2015 by 顾捷 + Zen Koh. Two product lines: medical rehab robotics (lower-limb exoskeletons + upper-limb / end-effector rehab) and full-size bipedal humanoid GR series. World's largest installed base of rehab robotics in first 8 years. (Duplicate entry — dedup merges with 'Fourier Intelligence'.)

entities.name: Luster LightTech
entities.summary: 凌云光 (SSE:688400). One of two-three Chinese national champions in industrial machine vision. '视觉 + AI' stack from vision components (cameras, lenses, lights, frame grabbers) up to vision systems and full intelligent-inspection equipment.

entities.name: Shuanglin Co
entities.summary: 双林股份 (SZSE:300100). Ningbo-based integrated auto-parts + robotics-parts maker; ChiNext-listed 2010. Controlling shareholder 宁波双林集团 (44.43%); 邬建斌 family ultimate controller.

entities.name: GAC Group
entities.summary: 广汽集团 (SSE:601238 / HKEX:02238). Guangzhou-municipal SOE auto group; rare A+H dual-listed Chinese auto SOE. Vehicle R&D + manufacturing + parts + commerce/mobility (incl. Robotaxi) + energy ecosystem (batteries, ESS).

entities.name: Hanwei Technology (corp)
entities.summary: 汉威科技 (SZSE:300007). China's largest domestic-owned gas-sensor maker + one of most-diversified IoT-stack operators. HQ Zhengzhou. Founded 1998 by chairman 任红军. ChiNext-listed 2009-10-30. (Same as 'Hanwei Technology' first-seeded with sector report — dedup merges.)

entities.name: Nabtesco

entities.name: Harmonic Drive Systems
entities.summary: 哈默纳科. Japanese harmonic-reducer leader — Leaderdrive's primary global competitor.

entities.name: ATL
entities.summary: Amperex Technology Limited — Hong Kong consumer-electronics Li-poly battery company. Robin Zeng (CATL founder) ran ATL 1999-2011 before spinning out the auto business as CATL. Now wholly owned by TDK.

entities.name: TDK
entities.summary: Japanese electronic-components company (TYO:6762); acquired ATL in 2005. Initially co-owned CATL but was forced to divest by 2015 China EV-battery whitelist.
